title: Polynomial-time construction of a delimited concatenation
statement: Let $m,T,z$ be polynomial-time computable functions from bit strings to bit strings. Then the function sending each bit string $x$ to the concatenation of $m(x)$, the bit $0$, $T(x)$, the bit $0$, and $z(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
